lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, I need to book an appointment for tomorrow morning, if possible.

lines.speaker: ella
lines.text: Good morning! Thanks for calling Sydney Medical Centre — this is Ella, your AI receptionist. Just a quick note, this call may be recorded. Let me check what's available... I have nine a-m or eleven thirty tomorrow with Doctor Patel — would either of those suit?

lines.speaker: ella
lines.text: Great, you're booked in for nine a-m tomorrow with Doctor Patel. Could I grab your name and a good email for the confirmation?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sure, it's David Chen — david dot chen at gmail dot com.

lines.speaker: ella
lines.text: Thanks, David — you're all set for nine a-m tomorrow, and I've sent the confirmation through to your email. Anything else I can help with today?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, that's everything. Thanks so much!
